teamExternals.purpose: Codex bridge — /codex:rescue second-opinion reviews and rescues
ruff / ty / uv guidance for Python repos
git worktree management via the wt CLI

baseline.description: Always-useful plugins to suggest on every setup (cc-setup), regardless of the repo's stack. The `always` set is language-agnostic; the `lsp` set is language-applicable — offer the entry whose `language` matches a detected language. Every id's @marketplace must be declared in `marketplaces` above. Caveat for marketplace repos: when the repo being set up is itself the `rdl-agent-extensions` marketplace (a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json named `rdl-agent-extensions`, e.g. agent-extensions), the gh@rdl-agent-extensions suggestion is removed by the cc-setup self-marketplace guard.

always.purpose: specialized PR-review subagents (silent-failure-hunter, type-design, etc.) — the team's default review toolkit
GitHub workflow — git hooks, changelogs, conventional commits, pull requests, releases, and CI/CD (the RDL gh plugin)
git worktree management via the wt CLI — parallel branches without re-cloning

lsp.purpose: gopls language-server integration for Go repos

baseline.lspNote: The official marketplace (anthropics/claude-plugins-official) ships per-language LSP plugins; gopls-lsp is the one the team pins. The marketplace-scout agent should enumerate that marketplace live for other *-lsp plugins (e.g. pyright/ty, typescript, rust-analyzer) and offer the one matching a detected language.
